speaker: john_heminges
text: Here is the first share since July on the cloth. Count your own: six-and-twenty shillings to each man.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Six-and-twenty. I have not heard that clink since the house went dark.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Six-and-twenty shillings. Count mine twice, John, so I know the dark weeks are over.

speaker: george_bryan
text: It is the same pile in front of each of us. I have counted mine. Six-and-twenty.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Six-and-twenty, and the first since July. I will not call it a fortune. I will call it a Saturday.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Take yours, Will, and tell me the yard over the water. How did he fill it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Gilded mail, and every inch of him, under the throne that has hung there since June. A fair house, not a great one.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And the king.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Their king is all is. Mine is all seems. Five weeks.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Five weeks is a rehearsal, not a bill. Monday at two is The Shrew.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The Shrew on Monday. I shall be glad of a play that lets a man breathe.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I still have Wednesday's eighteen lines in my head, and an apricock tree, and I would like a Saturday that is only money.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The money is on the cloth. Put it in your purse before the lane does.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mine goes into the purse, John, and not into the coffer. Twenty pound fifteen stays as I ruled it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I am not asking you to open a coffer. I am asking you to count six-and-twenty.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Counted. The cloth is clear on my side.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Monday at two, then. The Shrew, and a full week behind us.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am for my bed by nine tonight, John. The week has been long.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nine is early for a sharer. Go, if the week has been long.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You may go. Leave Monday's fourteen lines where the pen died. That was a good death for a pen.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The pen was Monday. Today is the cloth. Take your share.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And do not stand counting it in the lane. Six-and-twenty is a visible sum.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I am for the gate. The same to each of us, and I have seen it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Walk slow. Monday is two of the clock, and the bill is The Shrew.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Shrew at two. I have heard it. Good even.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good even. The share is told.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Good even, Will. Bed at nine. We will look for you when the bell says we should.
